title: Minimum wall thickness
description: The thinnest wall of every part, measured by rays cast into the material from sample points on every face.

suggested.title: Minimum wall thickness
suggested.description: No wall of the enclosure is thinner than 2.0 mm.
suggested.label: Walls at least 2.0 mm

title: Minimum draft angle
phrase: Draft at least {value} along the mold pull
description: The angle of every face that is not horizontal against the mold pull along Z.

suggested.title: Minimum draft angle
suggested.description: Faces parallel to the mold pull direction have at least 1° of draft.
suggested.label: Draft at least 1.0° along the mold pull

title: Overall height limit
description: The Z extent of the closed design, all parts together.

title: Minimum clearance to components
phrase: At least {value} from every board component
description: The exact distance from each board component's body to every part.

suggested.title: Minimum clearance to components
suggested.description: The enclosure stays at least 0.5 mm away from every board component.
suggested.label: At least 0.5 mm from every board component

title: Fit tolerance
description: Lid to base at the parting plane, and the walls of every opening against the size the board requires.

suggested.title: Fit tolerance
suggested.description: Mating features (lid to base, openings to components) are sized to ±0.2 mm.
suggested.label: Mating features fit to ±0.2 mm

title: Fit to the object
phrase: Takes up none of the object and comes within {value} of it
description: Every part against the object it is made to fit: no overlap, and the closest part within the gap.

suggested.title: Fit to the object
suggested.description: A part made to fit an object (a stand, a cover, a mount) takes up none of the object's volume and comes within 1.0 mm of it, so the object sits in it without play.
suggested.label: Takes up none of the object and comes within 1.0 mm of it

title: Material
description: The material each part is set up for, which the molding rules assume.

suggested.title: Molded ABS
suggested.description: The enclosure is injection-molded ABS, so molding rules (wall, draft) apply.
suggested.label: Made of molded ABS

title: Heat-set inserts
description: Every boss has a pocket that takes the insert, clear and deep enough, and the insert in it is seated within the fit tolerance.

dimensions.name: hole_diameter
dimensions.label: Pocket diameter
dimensions.description: The pocket the insert is pressed into

dimensions.name: insert_length
dimensions.label: Insert length
dimensions.description: The pocket is at least this deep

dimensions.name: screw_clearance
dimensions.label: Screw clearance hole
dimensions.description: The clearance hole for the screw in the mating part

suggested.title: M3 heat-set inserts
suggested.description: Fasteners go into M3 heat-set brass inserts pressed into bosses.
suggested.label: Fasteners go into M3 heat-set insert
